property_summary: For any caller, log address, lock time and amount, a Put() on C must record a LogFile message whose Sender equals that caller (via the log set by SetLogFile); the mutant never stores the Log reference, so the message is never written and History stays empty.
change_summary: Delete the assignment 'Log = LogFile(_log);' so the Log reference is never set and SetLogFile() always returns the zero address.
